aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:872.description: Fall Intern, Business Services (Procurement) For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! Job Summary: The AEG Internship Program offers a real-world experience that allows college students to learn the business of sports and live entertainment. In the Business Services Department, interns will gain insight into sourcing and procurement best practices, with a focus on supplier data analytics and IT product research. The intern will collaborate with stakeholders across IT, Presents, and AEG Sports Teams, and contribute to strategic initiatives in the following areas: Sourcing and negotiation Supplier data analysis and reporting Technology product research and purchasing Purchase order creation Forms and file management Responsibilities: Support strategic sourcing initiatives across departments Assist IT with procurement-related data and performance metrics Conduct supplier data analytics reviews and generate actionable reports Research and evaluate technology products for procurement consideration Engage with internal stakeholders to gather requirements and feedback Confirm vendor certification and/or membership status Update department spreadsheets and procurement dashboards Review and report on supply chain constraints and opportunities Identify and assess potential vendors and product solutions Process purchase orders, maintain filing systems, and track order status Follow up with suppliers to confirm or adjust orders as needed Provide support for various analyses and report creation Qualifications: Good customer service Good customer care Vendor relations Highly organized, resourceful, and dependable with excellent interpersonal skills and oral and written communication skills Ability to multi-task and work well under pressure Ability to use Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word The AEG Internship Program requires a minimum commitment of 18 hours per week during the fall. Benefit: Work on increasingly challenging and engaging real-world projects Gain hands-on experience in event planning, marketing initiatives, and business administration Collaborate with experienced sales and activation professionals Work closely with experienced team members who coach and provide mentorship Attend meetings, events, and other networking opportunities Intern Perks: Corporate networking Resume review Attend meetings, events, games, and other networking opportunities Pay Scale: $19.00 - $21.00 Location: Los Angeles (On-Site) Bonus: This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements. Excellent commercial awareness, drafting ability, communication, stakeholder-management and analytical skills, with the ability to deliver practical, business-focused advice in fast-paced transaction environments. beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:4c.title: Group CPO
beaconsoftware-beaconsoftware:ashbyhq:4c.description: Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies. They are niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore. Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently, accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable. We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better. Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game. ABOUT THE ROLE You'll be joining Beacon's Portfolio Product team as a Group CPO, owning product strategy and execution across a defined vertical within our portfolio. You'll start as a player-coach, directly embedded in 2-3 portfolio companies while building and eventually leading a team of PMs as your vertical grows. This is a senior, high-ownership role for someone who wants to shape how an entire industry segment gets transformed through AI and software. You'll be responsible not just for outcomes at individual companies, but for developing the playbooks, frameworks, and institutional knowledge that scale across every business in your vertical. What works in one portco should make every other portco better. That's the job. This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system. Key Responsibilities - Own product strategy and outcomes across a defined vertical within Beacon's portfolio - Directly manage 2-3 portfolio companies as a hands-on PM while building toward a team of 3-5 PMs over time - Hire, onboard, and develop PMs within your vertical as the portfolio scales - Develop and codify cross-portfolio playbooks that turn individual wins into repeatable systems - Partner with GMs, founders, and operators to set product vision and translate it into executable roadmaps - Drive quarterly and annual planning across your vertical, ensuring consistency and quality of product thinking - Set the bar for how great product work looks at Beacon — spec quality, customer discovery, prioritization rigor - Collaborate with engineering, data, and GTM teams to ship and scale features across multiple companies simultaneously - Contribute to Beacon's broader AI platform by surfacing patterns and opportunities from your vertical What We're Looking For - BA/BS Degree, MBA a plus - 7+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a formal leadership role or as a co-founder - Proven ability to lead and develop PMs, not just do great PM work yourself - Deep B2B SaaS experience, ideally across multiple products or business contexts - Strong systems thinker — you see patterns across companies and know how to turn them into playbooks - Comfortable operating across multiple businesses and stakeholders simultaneously - Ability to influence and earn trust with founders and executives without direct authority - High autonomy, low ego. You figure things out and get them done - Entrepreneurial mindset and genuine comfort with ambiguity This role is perfect for you if... - You've led a product team or co-founded a company and want to apply that experience

bloom-bloom:lever:5bff240b-c61c-4be7-a17.title: Brand Partnerships Manager
bloom-bloom:lever:5bff240b-c61c-4be7-a17.description: Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a Brand Partnerships Manager to join their dynamic team. As Talent Advisors, we serve as the bridge between our Bloom Partner and you throughout the recruitment process. At Bloom, we don’t rely on automated tools to sift through applications—every resume is carefully reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. If selected, you’ll join Poppy & Peonies directly as a valued member of their team. We’re excited to consider your application! Please note that applications will be accepted throughout the holiday season. Thank you for your patience and interest in this opportunity! Hi, I’m Natalie Dusome, Founder and CEO of Poppy & Peonies. At Poppy & Peonies, we’re a fun and energetic brand that believes style and function should always go hand-in-hand. We’re passionate about creating practical pieces that make life a little easier and literally lighten the load. Building Poppy & Peonies has been an incredible adventure. It all started when my daughter Poppy was born, and I found that my accessories no longer fit my new life as a mom. I needed bags with pockets and organization that looked cool but also had functionality. When I couldn’t find them, I decided to create them myself. And so, in 2015, Poppy & Peonies was born. We’ve come a long way since then—from filling orders in my basement to appearing on Dragons’ Den, and now, expanding into new product categories and collaborating with exciting influencers and brands. It hasn’t always been smooth sailing, but thanks to our incredible community, we’ve never felt more loved and supported!We believe in our responsibility to care for the environment and are passionate about preserving the health and welfare of our planet and the animals that live on it. That’s why all of our bags are made from high-quality vegan leather, and our entire product line is vegan, cruelty-free, and PETA-approved. We ship our products plastic-free and use a combination of recycled, compostable, and biodegradable materials to mitigate shipping waste. We are constantly looking for new ways to make our products and supply chain more sustainable, reducing our carbon footprint. As our Brand Partnerships Manager, you will lead one of the most exciting growth channels for Poppy & Peonies. You will be responsible for building and scaling our affiliate ecosystem with a strong focus on brand partnerships in the U.S. market. This role sits at the intersection of performance marketing, creator partnerships, and brand collaborations, helping us expand our reach through authentic relationships with creators, UGC partners and aligned brands. You will own the affiliate strategy end-to-end from everything outside of TikTok Shop such as identifying high-potential creators, optimizing performance, building long-term partnerships, and scaling the program into a major growth engine for the brand. This role is ideal for someone who understands the evolving world of social commerce, thrives on building relationships, and loves turning creator and brand partnerships into measurable revenue. Does this sound like you? Are you excited about scaling affiliate programs and creator partnerships? Do you thrive in the fast-moving world of influencers and social commerce? Do you love turning great partnerships into measurable business growth? If you answered yes, yes, and yes—keep reading!

brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:c2aab7c0-885d-45d6-b.title: Manager, DFR Field Operations
brinc-brinc:ashbyhq:c2aab7c0-885d-45d6-b.description: ABOUT BRINC: At BRINC, we are redefining public safety with an innovative ecosystem of life-saving tools. Our journey started with the development of drones and ruggedized throw phones, designed to access unsafe areas and establish communication to de-escalate situations. Today, we've expanded into creating and deploying 911 response networks, where drones are dispatched to 911 calls to provide real-time visual data, enhancing safety and enabling de-escalation-focused responses. Our cutting-edge solutions are utilized by over 600 public safety agencies across America and the company has raised over $150M from investors, including Index Ventures, Motorola Solutions, Sam Altman, Dylan Field, Mike Volpe, Alexandr Wang and more. At BRINC, we are committed to recruiting the world's best talent to join us in our mission to support first responders in saving lives. ABOUT THIS ROLE BRINC is looking for a dynamic, results-driven leader to join our team as Manager, DFR Field Operations. In this role, you'll lead a high-performing team of installation technicians responsible for deploying BRINC's industry-leading Drone as a First Responder (DFR) program at customer sites nationwide. You'll own the full operational lifecycle of multi-site hardware and software installations, driving execution in fast-paced, mission-critical environments. This is a role for someone with excellent organizational skills that brings both technical depth in drone systems and the operational savvy to keep complex deployments on track. The ideal candidate possesses experience in people management, computer networking, mechanical assembly, and general knowledge of electronics as it relates to hardware assembly and troubleshooting. The role requires frequent travel (75%)to engage with BRINC installers and on-site customers during the project management lifecycle. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Manage a team of installers, schedule resources for projects, track progress, optimize workflows, and ensure installations are completed on schedule. - Set clear expectations, goals, and performance standards while fostering an inclusive and positive team culture. - Conduct performance reviews and evaluations; facilitating training and skill development. - Participate in the hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members. - Drive customer success through building and maintaining strong relationships with Public Safety customers, understanding and proactively addressing their needs, concerns, and ensuring timely service throughout implementation. - Partner with engineering and internal stakeholders to inform best installation procedures, documentation, and hardware ecosystem enhancements based on field experience. Advocate for customer needs based on feedback - Collaborate with internal stakeholders to troubleshoot hardware and software issues. - Travel to customer sites in varying weather conditions to assemble, troubleshoot, and maintain BRINC hardware and software, ensuring compliance with building codes and safety standards. QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years in project, operations, or resource management; 4+ years managing people in a fast-paced environment. - Experienced in booking and managing all aspects of travel, including flights, accommodations, ground transportations, and itineraries. - Working knowledge of electronics, low/high voltage wiring, hardware assembly and troubleshooting; familiarity with MacOS, Windows, or Linux; basic networking aptitude. - Ability to assemble and disassemble products following installation guidelines and manuals. - Comfortable and able to safely work at heights (ladders, rooftops, structures), lift and carry heavy objects, and operate in varying weather conditions. - Exceptional organizational skills. - Self directed, collaborative, and an effective communicator; comfortable working autonomously. - Proven ability to thrive in fast-paced environments, leading with initiative and staying ahead of challenges before they arise. - Ability to trave

crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:98.title: Crane Operator - Maintenance
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:98.description: Come join our team at Optimal! We know a few things about competing with giants and exceeding expectations. After years of working in the field, our founders decided to break from tradition and build the company they wanted to work for. They believed in starting a company rooted in trust, its team, and the idea that everyone matters and has a part in getting the job done right. Quickly building a reputation from the ground up and growing the company along with our list of clients, Optimal is now influencing the industry and the people we serve. We live by the values that make us who we are. And that is how we deliver the impossible for our clients and team members every day. Crane Operators for Optimal Field Services will be responsible for operating a mobile crane to lift, move, position, and reposition loads. Crane Operators will be responsible for manipulating loads by operating crane controls such as depressing buttons, working foot pedals, and manipulating levers. The operator will receive direction from riggers and/or site supervision via verbal command or hand signals to determine required load movement. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: · Operates various types of cranes: All Terrain, rough terrain, crawlers, industrial, hydraulic trucks, conventional trucks, and boom trucks. · Operates crane to position and reposition loads where specified. · Directs activities of helpers in setting up and knocking down the equipment; placing cribbing blocks and /or pads, moves levers and foot pedals to rotate super structure, raise and lowers boom to raise and lower cables. · May operate crane according to signals from helpers and may bolt/pin boom sections together to modify boom lengths. · Perform routine maintenance on crane equipment. · Carry tools for running repairs · Properly barricades counterweight tail swing radius. · Must take complete charge of all safety pertaining to set up and knockdown and operation of crane. REQUIREMENTS FOR PIPEFITTERS: · Must have valid Driver’s License/ Identification Card. · Must be knowledgeable in OSHA Regulations in crane operations. · Must possess a current NCCCO or equivalent crane operator certification (Fixed and Swing Cab). · Must be able to pass a drug screen and physical.

ghj-ghj:lever:e8768307-dc22-426e-9817-2a.description: Build Relationships. Solve Business Challenges. Drive Growth. At GHJ Search & Staffing, we don't just fill jobs—we help middle-market companies build exceptional accounting and finance organizations. As part of GHJ, a nationally recognized accounting and advisory firm with 300 employees, 26 partners, and offices in Los Angeles, Orange County, San Jose, Denver, and Buffalo, our Search & Staffing professionals have a unique platform to deliver far more than recruiting. We partner with CFOs, Controllers, private equity firms, and business owners to provide interim staffing, executive search, direct hire recruiting, outsourced accounting, fractional CFO services, audit, tax, transaction advisory, and other consulting solutions. We're looking for an ambitious Business Solutions Manager who thrives in a consultative sales environment and enjoys developing long-term client relationships while recruiting top accounting and finance talent. This role offers the opportunity to build your own book of business while collaborating with one of the country's leading accounting and advisory firms. Why GHJ? At GHJ, you'll have the resources of a nationally recognized CPA and advisory firm combined with the entrepreneurial culture of a growing search and staffing practice. Position Overview The Business Solutions Manager is responsible for both business development and recruiting within the accounting and finance marketplace. This is a true "full desk" opportunity where you'll develop new client relationships, expand existing accounts, recruit top accounting and finance professionals, and manage the hiring process from initial client engagement through successful placement. Unlike traditional staffing firms, you'll leverage GHJ's extensive accounting and advisory platform to become a trusted Human Capital Advisor capable of solving broader business challenges for your clients.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:24eccac8-eb0d-.title: Data Governance Analyst
jobgether-jobgether:lever:24eccac8-eb0d-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Governance Analyst based in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to shape how critical enterprise data is governed, protected, and used across a large-scale modernization program. You will help establish practical governance frameworks, standards, and operating models that support data quality, security, privacy, and compliance. Working across business, technical, legal, security, and records management teams, you will turn complex requirements into clear and actionable controls. You will also contribute to data stewardship, metadata, lineage, classification, and governance maturity initiatives. The position combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a data-driven environment. It is well suited to an experienced governance professional who enjoys creating structure, improving data practices, and influencing teams through clear standards and collaboration. Support the development, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of data governance frameworks, policies, standards, procedures, and operating models. Act as a Data Standards Architect by defining and maintaining data standards, naming conventions, business definitions, data structures, reference data, and governance requirements. Align data governance practices with enterprise architecture, security, privacy, records management, and regulatory requirements. Establish clear data ownership, stewardship, accountability, and decision-rights models, including RACI structures across business and technical teams. Partner with Data Stewards, Data Owners, business stakeholders, security, privacy, legal, records management, and technology teams to operationalize governance requirements. Classify and manage data assets according to their sensitivity, criticality, business value, privacy requirements, and regulatory obligations. Translate policies and regulatory requirements into practical data governance controls, procedures, and operational processes. Identify governance gaps, risks, and compliance issues and coordinate appropriate remediation activities. Support data access, sharing, usage, and lifecycle governance processes while ensuring appropriate privacy and security controls. Participate in governance councils, working groups, and data domain forums, contributing expertise and helping drive consistent adoption. Create and maintain governance documentation, standards, procedures, decision logs, glossaries, lineage information, and supporting artifacts. Monitor the adoption and effectiveness of governance policies and standards and report program metrics, maturity, and compliance status to leadership. Support governance assessments, audits, compliance reviews, maturity evaluations, roadmaps, and continuous improvement initiatives. Develop training materials and deliver awareness sessions that help teams understand data governance policies, standards, and regulatory expectations. Requirements Master’s degree in a relevant field, with 5+ years of general experience in information systems and 7+ years of specialized experience, or equivalent demonstrated expertise. Demonstrated experience supporting or implementing enterprise data governance programs and operating models. Strong ability to translate governance policies and regulatory requirements into practical processes, controls, and delivery practices. Solid understanding of data quality management, metadata management, data stewardship, classification, and governance frameworks. Experience governing sensitive, regulated, or high-risk data within environments with strict compliance requirements. Hands-on experience with data quality profiling, monitoring techniques, and common data governance tooling. Experience defining and maintaining enterprise data standards across multiple teams, platforms, or delivery environments. Strong knowledge of data modeling, data integration patterns,

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4b01a305-707b-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AWS Cloud Engineer based in South Africa. This is a mid-level cloud engineering role focused on designing, deploying, and optimizing AWS environments for diverse client needs. You’ll work across a variety of cloud engagements, adapting solutions to different business requirements and technical challenges. The role combines hands-on infrastructure engineering with client advisory responsibilities, giving you the opportunity to influence cloud architecture and implementation. You’ll leverage infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, containerization, and automation to build reliable and scalable cloud environments. You’ll also identify infrastructure issues, improve performance and costs, and apply strong security practices throughout project delivery. The environment is dynamic and technology-focused, with opportunities to work across modern AWS services and evolving cloud technologies. Optimize cloud operations by identifying opportunities to improve system performance, scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency. Ensure data storage and processing solutions meet client requirements, policies, and operational standards. Apply AWS security best practices throughout architecture, deployment, configuration, and ongoing operations. Stay current with emerging AWS services, cloud engineering practices, automation technologies, and industry standards. Collaborate with engineering teams and clients to deliver effective solutions and adapt quickly to changing project requirements. Requirements Demonstrated experience working as a Cloud Engineer, AWS Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or in a closely related infrastructure role. Hands-on experience deploying and configuring AWS cloud resources in production or client environments. Strong Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform and/or CloudFormation . Practical experience building or supporting CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, CircleCI, GitHub Actions , or comparable platforms. Experience configuring Kubernetes clusters and deploying applications in containerized environments. Solid understanding of AWS networking, VPC architecture, and cloud security principles. Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure and application deployment issues using structured analytical and problem-solving approaches. Experience identifying opportunities for AWS performance, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization. Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure automation and configuration management practices. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and provide practical recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders. Strong adaptability and willingness to work across varied client environments and business requirements. An AWS Associate- or Professional-level certification is preferred. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a89d6129-d3e8-.title: Business Analyst –Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration
jobgether-jobgether:lever:a89d6129-d3e8-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Business Analyst – Data Sensitivity & VDI Migration based in Israel. This role offers the opportunity to shape how sensitive data is stored, accessed, and protected across a complex enterprise environment. You will assess data sensitivity, system usage, workflows, and storage practices across multiple business areas. A key focus will be identifying high-risk use cases and determining where VDI, stronger access controls, or other secure solutions can provide the best protection. You will translate detailed analysis into practical recommendations, business cases, and migration roadmaps. Working closely with Security, Technology, and business stakeholders, you will help align solutions with data protection and governance requirements. The role combines business analysis, data security, infrastructure, and stakeholder management in a highly collaborative environment. Your work will directly support stronger data protection, informed technology decisions, and sustainable security practices. Partner with business groups across the organization to inventory systems, tools, endpoints, and data usage patterns associated with physical device storage. Assess and classify data sensitivity across business units, systems, processes, and workflows, identifying areas of heightened security risk. Analyze data and process flows across systems, servers, networks, and endpoints to support risk assessments and migration planning. Identify critical systems and high-risk data storage practices that should be prioritized for migration to VDI or other secure data management solutions. Document current-state and proposed future-state data storage, access, and usage models. Evaluate viable solutions, including VDI, enhanced access controls, and other secure data management approaches, and recommend the most appropriate option for each use case. Develop business cases and recommendations for VDI migration, considering risk, cost, operational impact, and user adoption. Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops, and requirements-gathering sessions across departments. Collaborate with Security, Technology, and business teams to validate findings and ensure recommendations align with applicable data policies. Present analysis, findings, and recommendations clearly to technology leadership and other key stakeholders.
